verdict.degeneracy: real: evolving-depth variants exceed canonical and the free-exponent optimum sits on the scan boundary
verdict.interpretation: The sqrt(1+z) factor is compared against virial depth evolution Psi~E(z)^(2/3).  Evolving-depth variants outscore canonical after refitting kappa, and the free (s,p) optimum runs to the scan edge -- the score is monotone toward stronger z-weighting because the observables themselves trend with z, so the metric rewards extra redshift structure rather than discriminating the physical origin of that structure.  Conclusion: the kernel's redshift dependence is underdetermined by this sample; the canonical sqrt(1+z) form is not excluded, but it is also not selected -- it must be defended on theory grounds (conformal endpoint ratio) rather than claimed as data-preferred.
